basic_details.post_name: 2ND ANM, Nursing Officer NHM, Sr. Nursing Officer (NMHP) and 45 more
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Raigarh (Chhattisgarh) (Chief Medical and Health Officer, Raigarh) has invited applications for 180 posts in 48 roles under Advt No. NHM/HR/2026 33222. The posts include 2ND ANM, Nursing Officer NHM, Sr. Nursing Officer (NMHP), Laboratory Technicians (NHM) and 44 more. The online application is open from 24 November 2026 to 8 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years; maximum 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: 12th, ANM, B.Sc, GNM, Diploma, M.Sc, depending on the post

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 8,800 to Rs. 31,500, depending on the post

pattern_table.Subject: Written / computer based / proficiency test as per post

exam_pattern.details: Minimum 40% of total marks of the skill/written test required, else ineligible Skill test at district headquarters as required; no TA/DA paid

how_to_apply: Apply online at https://govthealth.cg.gov.in/recraigarh2026/ from 24-11-2026 to 08-12-2026 till 06:00 PM.
Register with mobile number; registration number and password are sent to the mobile.
Log in and fill the form in English capital letters only.
Pay the fee by scanning the QR code in the advertisement and upload the Transaction ID and receipt in PDF.
Upload photo (50 KB), signature JPG/JPEG (20 KB) and self-attested documents in PDF (500 KB).
Print the acknowledgement and keep it for document verification.
important_instructions: Separate application and separate fee for each post Eligible/ineligible list, test list, venue and results only on https://raigarh.gov.in and office notice board No new document accepted in claims-objections; only clerical errors corrected Category-wise waiting list valid one year or till new recruitment, whichever earlier Number of posts may be reduced, increased or cancelled for administrative reasons Where more than one qualification is attached, only the higher one is counted

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract appointment up to 31-03-2027; may be extended on satisfactory work and ROP approval from Government of India Annual performance evaluation; termination with 03 months notice if work unsatisfactory Either side may end service with one month notice or one month pay Post is non-transferable; appointment cancelled if not joined at the place and time ordered Agreement on Rs. 50 non-judicial stamp paper at candidate's cost

content_sections.heading: How Will Chief Medical and Health Officer, Raigarh Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and publication of provisional eligible/ineligible list for claims-objections Document verification / written test / computer based test / clinical skill based test Final merit list on marks for educational qualification, experience and skill/written test Candidates called for test: 10 times posts for 1-10 posts, 5 times for 11-50, 3 times for more than 50 Other posts: qualification 65%, experience 10/15 marks, written/skill test 20 marks Trained Mitanin ANM/GNM candidates: qualification/skill test/experience 60/20/20 Experience: 2 marks a year up to 10; NHM staff 3 marks a year up to 15 Covid-19 temporary workers with 6 months service: 10 bonus marks for Class III and IV posts Tie broken in favour of the older candidate, age as on 01-01-2026

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer, Raigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 8 December 2026. Applications opened on 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Chief Medical and Health Officer, Raigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 180 vacancies: 3 2ND ANM, 2 Nursing Officer NHM, 1 Sr. Nursing Officer (NMHP), 2 Laboratory Technicians (NHM), 9 Laboratory Technicians - BPHU, 4 Physiotherapist and 42 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer, Raigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Divyang/SC/ST/Women (pay up to Rs. 25000): Rs. 100. Divyang/SC/ST/Women (pay above Rs. 25000): Rs. 200. OBC (pay up to Rs. 25000): Rs. 200. OBC (pay above Rs. 25000): Rs. 300. Unreserved (pay up to Rs. 25000): Rs. 300. Unreserved (pay above Rs. 25000): Rs. 400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years; maximum 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 12000 for 2ND ANM, 16500 for Nursing Officer NHM, 31500 for Sr. Nursing Officer (NMHP), 14000 for Laboratory Technicians (NHM), 14000 for Laboratory Technicians - BPHU.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th, ANM, B.Sc, GNM, Diploma, M.Sc, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be native residents (mool niwasi) of Chhattisgarh. Live Nursing/Paramedical Council registration must be dated before the advertisement date where asked. All qualifications and registrations must be held before the advertisement date. Online form must be filled in English capital letters only.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose service was terminated by NHM or any government department for indiscipline, financial irregularity or misconduct. Candidates whose qualifying institution's recognition is dated after the advertisement date. Candidates who exert pressure or try to influence the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications and publication of provisional eligible/ineligible list for claims-objections. Document verification / written test / computer based test / clinical skill based test. Final merit list on marks for educational qualification, experience and skill/written test. Candidates called for test: 10 times posts for 1-10 posts, 5 times for 11-50, 3 times for more than 50.
